Conditions can be: you have a skill, a certain item is available, you have reached the required character level. <LINE> <LINE> Resources in your inventory are used to create items. Someone made a recording of a small part of the program.
Hi, I'm Kirk Cameron, your host for the Secrets of the Back to the Future trilogy.
We'll answer some of the burning questions that back to the future fans all over the world have asked us.
And as you can see, we have plenty of letters to choose from.
Hey, fella! Are you, Kirk Cameron?
This telegram just arrived for you.
Oh, hey, it looks like our first question. Mister Tommy from small village near Louisville writes:
Dear creators of Back to the Future, I, too, have a DoLorean car,
and I would like to make it into a time machine. Please share the recipes for making it.
Well, Tommy, Ronald Cobb - one of the creators of the design of the time machine
agreed to tell us more about the basic elements of the car,
as well as share the recipe for making them at home.
Hi, Tommy. The most recognizable part of the car is, of course, the nuclear reactor.
You can make something similar out of your hood. To do this you will need:
four METAL SHEETS, two METAL PIPES, one PLASTIC PIPE,
four sets of SCRAP ELECTRONICS and two ELECTRIC WIRES.
Of course, you can't do without a SAW, WELDER MASK and PROPANE TORCH.
And most importantly, don't forget to remove the REAR DOOR and REAR SIDE WINDOWS from the vehicle.
Otherwise you don't have enough space to install the reactor.
A temporary field igniter is installed at the front of the vehicle.
To create it, take a METAL SHEET and cut it with a SAW.
Weld the strips together using a PROPANE TORCH. The main thing is not to forget to wear a WELDER MASK.
Attach a pair of SCRAP ELECTRONICS, connect everything with ELECTRIC WIRES.
Screw the resulting structure to the body with a SCREWDRIVER on the five SCREWS.
After installing the previous two elements you can connect them to each other with two ELECTRIC WIRES.
In the third part of the movie, we had a box of electronic components installed on the trunk lid of the car.
To create it you need a SAW and a HAMMER.
Saw two PLANKS and staple them together with four NAILS.
Install a pair of SCRAP ELECTRONICS in the box and connect them with ELECTRIC WIRES.
Then secure the box to the trunk lid with two BELT.
These are probably all the basic components of a time machine that you can assemble for your DoLorean.
